beach.theme: a sunny British seaside beach cricket ground on a bright summer afternoon
beach.far: a turquoise sea with sailboats, a long wooden pier with a striped helter-skelter, and a red-and-white lighthouse on a headland under a blue sky
beach.sides: rows of candy-striped beach huts, deckchairs, buckets and spades, an ice-cream van and a lifeguard tower
beach.crowd: chunky holidaymakers in sunhats, knotted hankies and swimsuits, waving ice creams and inflatables

rockpool.surface: firm smooth pale silver wet sand
rockpool.theme: a hidden Cornish cove cricket ground at low tide on a breezy morning
rockpool.far: a great natural sea arch and dark granite cliffs with puffins and gulls, white cottages on the clifftop, sea spray and a fresh blue sky
rockpool.sides: big rounded granite boulders with glowing rock pools full of starfish, crabs and anemones, lobster pots and fishing nets
rockpool.crowd: chunky fans in bright yellow and blue waterproofs and wellies, holding crab buckets and shrimping nets
rockpool.light: cool fresh morning sun from top-right

harbour.theme: a busy Cornish fishing-harbour cricket ground on a sunny day
harbour.far: a curved harbour wall full of bobbing colourful fishing boats, a big red trawler, and a steep hillside of pastel-painted cottages up to the top edge
harbour.sides: stone quays stacked with lobster pots, crates of fish, coils of rope, bollards and a fish-and-chip kiosk
harbour.crowd: chunky fishermen in blue smocks and flat caps, families with fish and chips, gulls stealing chips

beachnight.theme: a beach-party cricket ground at night
beachnight.far: a dark blue sea under a huge full moon with fireworks bursting, palm trees and a glowing beach bar with fairy lights
beachnight.sides: bonfires, tiki torches, surfboards stuck in the sand, a DJ van and strings of coloured lanterns
beachnight.crowd: chunky party-goers in Hawaiian shirts and glow necklaces, dancing and waving glow sticks
beachnight.light: moonlight from top-centre plus warm firelight and lantern glow
beachnight.ring: dark driftwood logs with small glowing lanterns

storm.surface: smooth dark wet packed sand with a soft sheen
storm.theme: a cricket ground behind a sea wall in a wild storm
storm.far: enormous foaming waves crashing over a stone sea wall, a lighthouse in the spray, forks of lightning across a purple storm sky and an orange lifeboat riding the swell
storm.sides: a stone promenade with sandbags, wind-bent lamp posts, upturned umbrellas and puddles
storm.crowd: chunky fans in bright yellow raincoats and sou'westers, holding umbrellas blown inside-out, cheering in the rain
storm.light: cold storm light from top-right with a flash of lightning
